notes.title: Jerez's Arena III Early Access Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
Dear Gladiators,

Thank you all for your long-standing support and patience. We are thrilled to announce:

[b]- Early Access Release Date: June 9, 2025![/b]

Over the past period, we've poured our efforts into refining Jerez's Arena III. From story presentation and combat pacing to interface operations and overall performance, we've made comprehensive upgrades:

- More nuanced story presentation and voice details
- More intuitive shop and skill interface operations
- Significantly improved combat flow and resource loading

notes.title: Adventurer Chan! Surpasses 30,000 units and receives latest update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067364/0a316afa07a71b6c18efe2ff9af1b7ffc25332c5.png[/img]
Thank you all for your support of Adventurer-chan! 
We also have more good news to share with you!
To allow everyone to train Adventurer-chan from the beginning, 
we've now updated the game with a save data deletion feature. 
Additionally, we've added a Russian language version. 

We'd like to express our sincere gratitude for all players' support and feedback.
Alice Workshop is committed to bringing more fun games to all of you! 
Thank you very much!

(Translated by Claude)

．Fixed some tiny bugs.
